title: Claymore
tagline: Marketplace for selling codes or resell using polybase s a database
description: this project is a market place to sell codes of products as games or amazon or anything that has codes, to resell or sell directrly without credit or debit card, We made it in solidity to make the smart contrats, alchemy to deployor project polybase as a database and nextjs for the forntend
